title: Finset indicator on a finite index type
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite type and let $S$ be a finite subset of $\iota$. Its indicator is the function from $\iota$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$ that equals $1$ on $S$ and $0$ outside $S$.
